text:
maya.s: Getting a sudden spike of 403s from a handful of webhook consumers in EU. Started ~09:12 UTC after the midnight vault maintenance?

maya.s: Example error in logs: `auth: signature verification failed` and `key-id: ka-2025-03-11`

jamie.t: Are those the keys that rotated overnight? I see a vault rot job at 00:10 UTC with ID rot-20250311-7.

carlos_i: Confirmed: vault transit rewrap happened and a new KMS alias was applied. The rewrap step changed the wrapping key metadata. Some long-lived API keys for webhooks are using client-side cached wrapped keys.

rachel_sre: Do we have repro steps? Any specific consumer showing the issue?

maya.s: Repro: 1) Use old wrapped token stored in consumer DB 2) POST webhook to EU ingest 3) Ingest rejects with 403 + `invalid_signature`

maya.s: Log snippet:```
2025-03-11T09:12:34Z ingester auth.go:142 ERROR token validation failed: invalid_signature wrap_key_id=ka-2025-03-11 prev_alias=alias/old-kms
2025-03-11T09:12:34Z ingester http.go:87 WARN rejected request from 52.16.128.9
```

carlos_i: Looks like our server-side unwrap expects the current KMS alias to match the wrap metadata. When alias was rotated we re-wrapped new tokens but older wrapped tokens cannot be unwrapped because the alias change invalidates the envelope key in some HSM configs.

ops-bot: Note: temporary mitigation - we added a fallback to try previous alias for 1 hour after rotation (rolled out to canary).

deploy-bot: canary-20250311-7 deployed to 10% of EU pods at 09:20 UTC (fallback-previous-alias=true)

deepa_cust: Our integration customers are hitting this; one reported webhook retries don't get through. Any ETA on fix?

rachel_sre: Short-term: roll back alias change or enable previous-alias fallback globally. Medium-term: update unwrap logic to try both alias versions for the configured grace window and add a rewrap workflow for stored consumer tokens.

jamie.t: Workaround steps we gave to customers: 1) rotate their stored wrapped key by triggering an API re-issue (POST /v1/keys/refresh) OR 2) wait ~1 hour for fallback to be enabled then resend failed webhooks.

carlos_i: Action items: - Enable fallback globally (rachel) - Add a migration to rewrap stored wrapped tokens in the db (eng-infra) - Update rotation runbook to change KMS alias before rewrap step next time (ops) - Create a postmortem and notify affected customers (support)

rachel_sre: I'll enable fallback now and follow up with a rollback plan if any edge pods start hitting decrypt errors.

maya.s: Created support ticket INC-20250311-94 and pinged affected customers. Putting this on high priority. :warning:

jamie.t: Also note billing: one customer reported spikes in retry traffic, billing team looped in for credits.

carlos_i: Long-term suggestion: add a rewrap endpoint our SDKs can call so consumers can transparently refresh stored wrapped keys without manual steps.

rachel_sre: Thanks team — keeping thread open until fallback fully rolled out and incident is closed. :white_check_mark:
